intro: With great explosive barrels comes great responsibility.
description:
Sword? Check.
Horse? Of course.
Explosive barrels? You'd better believe it!

Choose your side, arm yourself with your favorite weapons, and charge into large-scale medieval battles. Fight with swords, bows, spears, crossbows, shields, and even magic. Capture flags to respawn closer to the front line, ride into combat on horseback, and use everything at your disposal to help your team claim victory.

Battle across snowy fields, islands, and mountain fortresses, experiment with different tactics, and always keep an eye on your surroundings—sometimes a single well-placed explosive barrel is all it takes to change the course of the battle.
